prompts: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a landscape English Study Buddy revision infographic titled "Reporting tools and source checks". Warm white, navy, muted teal, restrained amber, spacious professional adult-learning style, highly readable text. Upper section three illustrated document cards: "Narrative report" / "Explain evidence for a reader"; "Notebook" / "Code, outputs and explanation"; "Plain Markdown" / "Formatting, not an analysis engine". Lower section: three website cards with arrows tracing back to ONE original document, labelled "Trace the original evidence". Adjacent magnifier callouts: "Check author, date and scope", "A repost is not independent confirmation", "Evaluate claims, not tone alone". Footer "Original Study Buddy practice • Lesson 2.1". No real article claims, software screenshots, official quiz text, statistics, logos or completed-study checkmarks. Conceptual study aid; use only short accurate English labels.

Use case: scientific-educational. Create a landscape English Study Buddy revision infographic titled "Build a report the reader can check". Warm white, navy, muted teal, restrained amber, spacious adult-learning editorial style with highly readable English. Main illustrated chain of four cards: "Purpose" / "What decision matters?"; "Evidence" / "Data, method and clear labels"; "Interpretation" / "What does the result mean?"; "Conclusion" / "Answer within the evidence". Lower left shows a generic unnumbered vertical column-chart icon with a visible zero baseline labelled "Columns compare category magnitudes". Lower right two small document icons labelled "Heading styles create structure" and "A chart picture needs updating when data change". Footer "Original Study Buddy practice • Lesson 2.2". No actual dataset, numerical findings, fake Word interface, official quiz questions, logos or implied completed student work.

Use case: scientific-educational. Create a landscape English Study Buddy revision infographic titled "From EDA to a readable infographic". Warm white, navy, muted teal and restrained amber, highly readable English and generous space. Three illustration cards left to right: "Question + data" / "Inspect variables, units and missingness"; "Appropriate evidence" / "Choose charts for the question"; "Visual message" / "Headline, context, evidence, limits and sources". Below, two distinct file icons connected to a GIMP-style conceptual layer stack, not a software screenshot: "Save XCF" / "Editable working project"; "Export JPEG" / "Flat sharing image". Separate note "Choose dimensions for the audience; an example is not a rule." Footer "Original Study Buddy practice • Lesson 2.3". No real measured charts, invented numbers, copied quiz material, logos or completion claims.

Use case: scientific-educational. Create a landscape English Study Buddy revision infographic titled "Communicate evidence as a team". Warm white, navy, muted teal and restrained amber, clear adult-learning editorial style, spacious readable English. Top illustrated chain: "Ben" / "EDA evidence" → "Anna" / "Report structure" + "Chris" / "Visuals and explanations" → "Team leader" / "Stakeholder speech". A small separate preparatory card above says "Anna + Chris: dataset shortlist". Bottom two areas: "Adapt detail, preserve facts and limits" with technical and nontechnical audience figures, and "Match tense to status" with "Past: completed" / "Future: planned" / "Conditional: hypothetical". Footer note "Leader's speech: at least two pages • approximately 800–1000 words". Small secondary footer "Original Study Buddy practice • Lesson 2.4". No invented findings, official quiz content, screenshots, logos, or checkmarks suggesting completed teamwork.
